paper_metadata.title: Phase-Field Study of Anisotropic g0-Coarsening Kinetics in Ni-Base Superalloys with Varying Re and Ru Contents

evidence.section: 1. Introduction
evidence.quote: The typical microstructure of single crystalline Ni-base cast alloys consists of cuboidal g0-precipitates coherently embedded in a continuous g-matrix (Ni). The extraordinary thermo-mechanical properties of the Ni-base superalloys largely depend on the morphology, distribution, size, and volume fraction of the g0-precipitates.
